gifenc, GIF encoder and colour quantiser (used by /video-to-gif/)
=================================================================

Files
  gifenc.esm.js      dist/gifenc.esm.js from the package, the minified ES
                     module build, unmodified. It exports GIFEncoder,
                     quantize, applyPalette and helpers. The page loads it
                     in a module Web Worker only once a video is opened.
  gifenc.esm.js.map  dist/gifenc.esm.js.map from the package, unmodified
                     (the source map named on the last line of the module,
                     so browser developer tools find it instead of a 404).
  LICENSE.txt        LICENSE.md from the package, renamed only.

  Package:  gifenc 1.0.3 (MIT), by Matt DesLauriers, published 7 March 2021
  Source:   https://registry.npmjs.org/gifenc/-/gifenc-1.0.3.tgz
            https://github.com/mattdesl/gifenc
  sha1 of the tarball (matches the registry's shasum):
            3a1a97fa5ab70ebefd000350b9aac8313b30b3aa
  sha256 of the tarball:
